reviews.author: Chad D
reviews.text: Prices are very high drive eight minutes and go to anyone else $30 to mount one tire on a rim that’s already taken off and there is no need for balancing That’s outrageous Belton tire eight minutes down the road will do it for eight bucks the fair with your pricing and $30 for a trailer tire that does not need balancing and already off. The rim is ridiculous. Even Firestone will do it for 18 and balance it.

reviews.author: The Channel
reviews.text: Shep was the NICEST and most helpful! He fit us in next day, carefully explained each thing that needed fixing and helped me plan a diagnostic list for future repairs that were not imminent but helped me see “what’s next” so that I can keep my truck in good repair! Honea path Auto sales and services is the best! Thank you!

reviews.author: Rhonda Pitts
reviews.text: This is a great shop! My son had some work done on his car and was super happy with the work and recommended it to me when I mentioned I needed work on my car. They changed the breaks one day and made an appointment the following week for struts, tie rod ends and all that goes with it. Very reasonably priced. Definitely recommend and will be back!

reviews.author: David w Elwood
reviews.text: Very prompt Barry to the point and my vehicle was done within three days. It was a big job. The price was very good. Actually it was lower than a lot of the other places and I haven’t had a problem with my vehicle ever since they worked on it very understanding and I would definitely recommend this to friends and family. Anyone who needs their vehicle worked on in a timely fashion And very good. Of technicians to understand all kinds of vehicles and get your job done right. I just want to say thank you to Honea Path auto sales and service.

reviews.author: Austin Watt
reviews.text: Bought a new set of tires Friday and was told to come back Monday for installation. Paid for tires on Friday and when I arrived on Monday at 10:15am the business is closed.

reviews.author: Hope Casey
reviews.text: I recommend this place to everyone who needs any type of work done in their vehicles. Our first experience with them was getting tires for our car. They were able to get them same day and at an amazing price. Just recently we needed a fuel pump replaced. They got it finished same day. They are amazing. We won’t take our cars any where else.

reviews.author: Michael Ewen
reviews.text: moved to the area about a year and a half ago, after the first visit to the shop I was satisfied with the service . I have been taking my vehicles there ever since. My wife daughter and son also have their vehicles serviced there.

reviews.author: Ashley Carroll
reviews.text: First off they are con artist. The mechanic shep is not an honest mechanic. He doesn’t diagnose your vehicle, over price shop lies about the pricing once you bring car to shop price changes. Went in for a starter replace told me $200,got it towed to his shop then later the next day he said it will be $600. This company is not a trust worthy company they really don’t know how to fix cars really conning people out they money. Short story I told him to put my car back and do not fix found 3 differ other mechanics that charge me from 150 to 200 just to replace starter. This company are liars if you want more damage and higher price go for them.

reviews.author: Nellie Mckethan
reviews.text: I've always been pleased with their service. After being told by another mechanic that he couldn't fix the problem, Shepp told me to bring it back and he would fix it. And Did thank you

reviews.author: Daniel Hatcher
reviews.text: Brought my car here to get fixed, I left it there for weeks and it still wasn't fixed. I came to pick up my car and he threatened me I had to pay him or I wasn't getting my car. He called police thinking he was gonna steal my car from me when he did no work at all.

reviews.author: Tyliyah Johnson
reviews.text: My experience here did not even need one star. My car was with these people for a week. I called and asked them did the fix alternator s because that’s what my car needed they said yes. After a week I call to see if it was done they said yes. I go to get my car he dose not even tell me what he did he just says it’s 130.00. So I’m like okay did you fix the alternator. He replies it didn’t need a starter. I never said starter I said alternator. I said well can I have a list of what you fixed? He said the only thing we did was put a battery in. Mind you they had it for a week. I said and that fixed it he said yea I drove it around ( mind you the battery light is still on) so they knew it wasn’t fix. What’s sad is we live in a very dangerous world and they didn’t care that my car would break down on the side of the road because they didn’t fix the alternator as I requested. I would not tell a enemy to go to this place.

reviews.author: Krista Brock
reviews.text: They get the job done fast and spur of the moment flat tire, no problem. I was right back on the rode in less than 15 minutes. Thank you.

reviews.author: Mimi R
reviews.text: The lead mechanic is no longer there. I would not recommend this place. Grossly overpriced. Unknowledgeable and plain out deceitful.

reviews.author: Lisa Burnett
reviews.text: I have been here several times and have had nothing but GREAT service! They are fast and dependable!!!
